events.verdict: Goodwin (PHX) and DiVincenzo (MIN) both go to the ground on their own accord and the contact as they pursue the loose ball is incidental.
Prior to the timeout by Minnesota, Brooks (PHX) and Randle (MIN) both make clean contact with the ball throughout the pursuit for the loose ball.
Randle (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects it away from O'Neale (PHX).
O'Neale (PHX) initiates body contact with Randle (MIN) that affects his shot attempt near the rim.
O'Neale (PHX) delivers contact to Randle (MIN) during the rebound.
McDaniels (MIN) extends his arms into O'Neale (PHX) as he disengages.
Dunn (PHX) initiates body to body contact with DiVincenzo (MIN) that affects his SQBR.
Gobert (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position as Gillespie (PHX) loses control of his dribble on his own.
McDaniels (MIN) legally contests Brooks' (PHX) jump shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) places his left hand on O'Neale's (PHX) body during the putback shot at the basket, and the contact is marginal.
Gillespie (PHX) immediately slides his hand off DiVincenzo's (MIN) body before reaching out to cleanly deflect the pass away.
Brooks (PHX) grasps and releases Edwards' (MIN) jersey as they move alongside each other up the court.
Brooks (PHX) brings his hand toward the ball and brushes Randle's (MIN) arm as Randle makes his intended pass.
Brooks (PHX) makes contact to the ball and causes it to become loose and any ensuing contact with Randle's (MIN) wrist is incidental.
Edwards (MIN) absorbs the marginal contact from Goodwin (PHX) and legally contests the shot at the basket.
Goodwin (PHX) makes clean contact with the ball and deflects away Randle's (MIN) pass attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Brooks (PHX) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Brooks extends his arms and initiates illegal contact with Randle (MIN) as he defends the play.
Dunn (PHX) wraps his arm around and initiates body to body contact with Edwards (MIN) that affects his SQBR.
Williams (PHX) and Gobert (MIN) engage and immediately disengage as they pursue the rebound.
DiVincenzo (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Gillespie's (PHX) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Dunn (PHX) legally contests Randle's (MIN) jump shot attempt and the marginal lower body contact after the release is created by Randle.
